description: Unified Theory, equation kit. 18 skills (6 per scientist), each also usable as a reserved trait; up to 4 reserved + 1 cast = a 5-step combo on 5 independently recharging charges. Distances in game units, times in ticks (60/s), ratios in percent. Science 0 Einstein, 1 Newton, 2 Curie (the persona art order).

skills.name: Apple
skills.text: Lobs an apple that lands where the target will be. Damage grows with the drop height h (cast distance, up to +60%); 0.5 s root.
skills.ideal: Cast from the edge of its range: h is largest.

skills.name: Prism
skills.text: A white beam that refracts into red, green and blue rays (40% each) at its first hit. The closer the hit, the wider the refraction angle.
skills.ideal: Hit a target standing in front of others: the three rays find them.

skills.name: Orbit
skills.text: A planet that flies out, then circles its arrival point once, pulling and striking enemies it passes (every 0.25 s). Force ∝ 1/r²: cast point-blank it hits up to 160%, from far 50%.

skills.name: Cradle
skills.text: Newton's cradle: strikes the first enemy in a line, then the momentum passes to the last enemy in that line (+15% per body between), knocking it back.
skills.ideal: Line up several enemies: the last one takes the conserved momentum.

skills.name: Third Law
skills.text: A 1.5 s shield (40 + 30% AP). When it ends, every enemy within 22000 is pushed away and takes 20 + 30% of the damage Newton took meanwhile.
skills.ideal: Cast when focused: the reaction equals the action.

skills.name: Calculus
skills.text: Marks a target for 3 s. Unified's next hit on it adds 35% of the HP it lost in the last 2 s (up to 8% of its max HP + 60).
skills.ideal: Mark a target the team is already damaging.

skills.name: Radium
skills.text: A glowing sample. Every 0.25 s it hits enemies inside for a dose that halves every 2 s (half-life). Recasting it on a live sample enriches it: N₀ resets.
skills.ideal: Place it where enemies will stay; enrich it before it decays.

skills.name: Alpha
skills.text: A heavy, short ray: high damage, stopped by the first body it hits.
skills.ideal: Use at close range on the front target.

skills.name: Beta
skills.text: A charged ray that curves toward the nearest enemy (Lorentz force) and passes through one body.
skills.ideal: Fire at a moving target: the field bends it in.

skills.name: Gamma
skills.text: A long ray through walls and every body; each body crossed attenuates it to 85%.
skills.ideal: Fire along a line of enemies, or through a wall.

skills.name: Half-life
skills.text: A damage over time that halves every second: a, a/2, a/4, a/8, a/16. The total converges to 2a.
skills.ideal: Apply early: the series needs time to sum.

skills.name: Chain Reaction
skills.text: Jumps up to 4 times to enemies within 25000, each jump × k. Subcritical k = 0.7; critical k = 1.0 when it starts inside Radium.
skills.ideal: Start it inside Radium for k = 1.

skills.name: Time Field
skills.text: A field of dilated time for 3 s: enemies inside are slowed 15% plus up to 30% more the faster they move (γ); allies inside move 15% faster.
skills.ideal: Drop it on fast movers: γ grows with v.

skills.name: E = mc²
skills.text: A bolt that converts mass into energy: 20 + 4% of the target's max HP as true damage. Through a Time Field its detonation waits 1 s and gains 25%.
skills.ideal: Hit the heaviest target: m is its max HP.

skills.name: Einstein Ring
skills.text: A gravitational lens for 4 s: a pulse hits enemies inside, and Unified's projectiles that pass through bend toward the nearest enemy with +15% damage.
skills.ideal: Place it between Unified and the target before firing rays.

skills.name: Twin Paradox
skills.text: An ally (or Unified) returns to where they were 3 s ago and to that HP if it was higher (up to 20% of max HP); the arrival pulses for 20 + 20% AP. The same ally can travel once a minute.
skills.ideal: Save an ally who just lost a lot of HP.

skills.name: Spacetime Well
skills.text: Curved spacetime for 2 s: enemies inside are pulled toward the centre, harder the closer they are (∝ 1/r²), and take a small hit every 1/3 s.
skills.ideal: Group enemies before Radium, Prism or Gamma.

skills.name: Photoelectric
skills.text: A photon that only frees energy above the work function: against a target carrying ≥ 2 of Unified's marks it deals 60 + 75% AP (+10% per extra mark); otherwise a weak 15%.
skills.ideal: Fire after two other effects have marked the target.

traits.name: Drop
traits.hit: an apple falls on each hit point 0.3 s later (30% damage, 0.3 s root)
traits.zone: apples rain inside it (one every 0.5 s)

traits.name: Split
traits.hit: the first hit splits into 3 small lasers (20% each)
traits.zone: it fires a small laser (20%) at an enemy inside every 0.5 s

traits.name: Orbit
traits.hit: a small planet circles each hit point once (2 extra 25% hits)
traits.zone: it rotates, dragging enemies inside along its rim

traits.name: Transfer
traits.hit: each hit repeats on the farthest enemy behind the target (70%)
traits.zone: its last tick repeats on the farthest enemy behind it

traits.name: Recoil
traits.hit: hits knock targets back 6000 and shield Unified for 8% of the damage
traits.zone: enemies leaving it are knocked outward

traits.name: Derivative
traits.hit: hits add 20% of the target's HP loss over the last 2 s
traits.zone: its ticks add 10% of each target's recent HP loss

traits.name: Irradiate
traits.hit: each hit leaves a small radium puddle (1.5 s, decaying)
traits.zone: it irradiates: its ticks also apply a decaying dose

traits.name: Curve
traits.hit: projectiles home toward the nearest enemy
traits.zone: it drifts toward the nearest enemy

traits.name: Penetrate
traits.hit: ignores walls and pierces every body
traits.zone: it ignores walls and its radius +20%

traits.name: Decay
traits.hit: hits add a halving damage over time worth 2 × 15% of the hit
traits.zone: its ticks add a halving damage over time

traits.name: Chain
traits.hit: each hit jumps to one more enemy within 25000 (× k)
traits.zone: its ticks jump to one enemy outside it (× k)

traits.name: Dilate
traits.hit: hits slow targets by 15% + γ (up to 30% more) for 1.5 s
traits.zone: enemies inside are also slowed by γ

traits.name: Mass
traits.hit: hits add 2% of the target's max HP as true damage
traits.zone: its ticks add 0.5% of max HP as true damage

traits.name: Lens
traits.hit: a projectile bends once toward the nearest enemy (+15%)
traits.zone: Unified's projectiles crossing it bend toward the nearest enemy (+15%)

traits.name: Rewind
traits.hit: the cast echoes 1 s later from the same origin (60%)
traits.zone: it reopens 1 s after it closes (60%)

traits.name: Pull
traits.hit: hits pull targets 8000 toward the cast's path or centre
traits.zone: it pulls enemies inside toward its centre

traits.name: Threshold
traits.hit: × 1.8 damage on targets carrying ≥ 2 of Unified's marks
traits.zone: its ticks deal × 1.8 to targets carrying ≥ 2 marks

unification.name: Unified Burst
unification.text: +30% damage and a second strike at the last target (40% of the combo).

unification.name: Unified Field
unification.text: Enemies within 18000 of the last target are pulled together and rooted 0.4 s.

unification.name: Unified Life
unification.text: Unified heals 30% of the combo's damage.

unification.name: Unified Shield
unification.text: Unified gains a shield of 12% max HP for 3 s.

unification.name: Unified Proof
unification.text: The last target takes true damage equal to 8% of its missing HP.

unification.name: Unified Motion
unification.text: Unified moves 30% faster for 2 s and the oldest recovering charge returns.

signatures.name: Criticality
signatures.text: k = 1.0: the chain never weakens, and it passes through walls.

signatures.name: Newton's Garden
signatures.text: Apples orbit the well and fall in (4 extra drops).

signatures.name: Focused Lens
signatures.text: The 3 lasers converge into one beam at × 2.

signatures.name: Relativistic Derivative
signatures.text: Damage × γ of the target (up to +50%).

signatures.name: Isotope
signatures.text: The zone's half-life doubles to 4 s.

signatures.name: Momentum Drop
signatures.text: The drop knocks the whole line back.

signatures.name: Full Spectrum
signatures.text: Alpha, beta and gamma rays all leave from one cast (50% each).

signatures.name: Closed Timelike Curve
signatures.text: The orbit repeats twice.

signatures.name: Cascade
signatures.text: Each marked target hit adds a jump.

signatures.name: Bent Momentum
signatures.text: The transfer goes around corners (ignores walls).

signatures.name: Event Horizon
signatures.text: Enemies pulled into the zone are slowed up to 60%.

signatures.name: d/dt of Decay
signatures.text: Detonates every remaining damage over time instantly.

signatures.name: Principia
signatures.text: A full Newton line; knock-chain through every enemy hit.

signatures.name: Curie's Notebook
signatures.text: A zone that emits alpha, beta and gamma rays every 0.5 s.

signatures.name: Annus Mirabilis
signatures.text: The bolt fires, rewinds and fires again, lensed.

signatures.name: Reactor
signatures.text: A lasing well that chains between irradiated targets at k = 1.

signatures.name: Accretion Disk
signatures.text: Orbiting damage over time pulled into a well that lasts 50% longer.

signatures.name: Execution Proof
signatures.text: Marked, damaged targets take a further 6% max HP burst.

signatures.name: Light Show
signatures.text: Every ray homes and pierces, through walls.

signatures.name: Conservation
signatures.text: Pulled together, then knocked apart twice.

signatures.name: Fallout
signatures.text: Apples irradiate wherever they land, and the irradiation chains.

signatures.name: Magnetosphere
signatures.text: A slowing ring that curves projectiles inward.

signatures.name: Interferometer
signatures.text: Each laser adds Derivative.

signatures.name: Gravity Lesson
signatures.text: The momentum line runs twice, 1 s apart.

signatures.name: Grand Synthesis
signatures.text: N→C→E in one cast: lasers, drops and a mass-energy burst.

signatures.name: Chain Meltdown
signatures.text: A critical chain inside a pull zone.

signatures.name: Solar System
signatures.text: Planets, a lensed well and slowed bodies; apples rain.

signatures.name: Laser Physics
signatures.text: × 2 Split, focused, threshold-boosted.

signatures.name: Integral of Time
signatures.text: Repeats all damage over time dealt in the last 3 s, then fires again.

signatures.name: Three Laws
signatures.text: Pull, orbit, knock: a full control sequence.

signatures.name: Radioactive Series
signatures.text: Each jump steps one ray down the decay series.

signatures.name: Time Loop
signatures.text: The orbit replays 3 ×.

signatures.name: Spectroscopy
signatures.text: Reveals and marks every enemy hit for 4 s.

signatures.name: Pinball
signatures.text: A bouncing transfer that knocks each target.

signatures.name: Dark Matter
signatures.text: A well that bursts when its targets carry 2 marks.

signatures.name: Theory of Everything
signatures.text: Cast the ultimate with these 4 reserved: the fifth step is the ultimate itself.
